description: This source file defines the class PdfImportedObjectTable, which manages imported objects of an external PDF document within the PDFsharp library. It handles caching of imported objects, their references, and provides methods to access and manipulate these objects during PDF processing.

classes.name: PdfImportedObjectTable
classes.description: Represents a cache of imported objects from an external PDF document, facilitating object reuse and reference management during PDF manipulation.

methods.name: PdfImportedObjectTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the imported object table with owner and external document context.

methods.name: GetXObject
methods.description: Retrieves the imported form XObject for a specific page number.

methods.name: SetXObject
methods.description: Sets the form XObject for a specific page number in the cache.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an external object identifier has already been imported.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new external object and its reference to the cache.
